  "name": "react-example",
  "private": true,
  "version": "0.0.0",
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "PORT=3000 tsx server.ts",

    "ws": "^8.22.0"
  },

    "@types/node": "^22.14.0",
    "@types/react": "^19.3.0",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19.3.0",
